messages:
maria_sales: Quick one — ACME is asking for pricing for our compliance add-ons as part of a 12mo $200k commit. They specifically want: audit log retention (7 years), KMS/HSM key custody option, and HIPAA attestation. Can we get a consolidated quote + any discount we can offer?

sam_se: copying in legal & dealdesk. do we have a standard SKU for long-retention logs? also need to confirm whether HSM is customer-managed or our managed HSM.

olivia_legal: For HIPAA + KMS/HSM we need to confirm key custody. If customer wants BYOK with HSM, add legal review for terms (key escrow, access). Also need data residency clause if they require EU-only.

raj_dealdesk: High level — we can do the following pricing tiers. Tentative discount windows for a 12mo commit: up to 10% auto-approve, 10-20% requires manager, >20% needs director.

raj_dealdesk: ```Line items:
- Audit logs (30d default): $0.02 per GB-month
- Extended retention (7y snapshot): $0.005 per GB-month additional
- KMS/HSM (managed): $1,500/month per tenant
- KMS BYOK (customer HSM integration): $3,000 one-time integration + $800/month
- HIPAA compliance add-on (attestation + BA): $2,500/year
Notes: Pricing assumes <50TB total log storage.```

henry_support: ops note — 7yr retention will increase storage and egress for restores. Recommend recommending lifecycle tiering (hot for 90d, cold after) to keep costs reasonable. Also audit log ingest rate: if >500MB/s we'll need dedicated pipelines (additional infra charge).

maria_sales: ACME's legal asked if we can waive the $3k one-time for BYOK and instead roll into the commit. they say they can sign faster if that fee is removed.

olivia_legal: We can consider waiving the one-time integration fee up to a threshold if commit >= $200k, but require a clause: integration rollback window + schedule. Also need to confirm who owns HSM configuration and incident response playbook.

raj_dealdesk: Given the $200k commit, approved options: 10% discount on add-ons + waive up to $1,500 of the one-time BYOK fee. Anything beyond that needs director signoff. We can present a counter: 15% total discount if they move to 24mo commit.

maria_sales: client pushes back — they want full waiver of the 1-time BYOK fee and 15% off add-ons for 12mo. timeline: they need final before EOD Friday.

sam_se: if they need EOD, we should surface the operational risks in the quote: BYOK integration typically takes 2-3 weeks windows. can't promise same-day. include POC timeline in the SOW.

olivia_legal: I'll draft conditional language: waive $1.5k fee if no changes in scope within 30 days and commit is executed. For 15% discount we need manager approval.

raj_dealdesk: Manager approval request: granting 15% discount on compliance add-ons for 12mo $200k commit and full waiver of BYOK one-time fee. I'm +1 but need manager signoff. tagging manager.

compliance-bot: <https://internal.redwood.com/docs/compliance-packages|SOC2/HIPAA package> — includes standard SOW language for audit-log retention and KMS options.

henry_support: If we waive BYOK fee, ops can still bill for extra infra (if load > planned). suggest adding a contingency line: "Additional integration effort billed at $150/hr beyond X hours" so we don't eat open-ended labor.

maria_sales: ok — i'll present: 15% off add-ons + waiver of BYOK fee contingent on SOW limits + additional-hours clause. will ask ACME to sign LOI by Friday.

raj_dealdesk: if manager approves before EOD I can route for director sign-off same day. otherwise fallback offer: 10% + $1,500 waiver.

olivia_legal: I'll prepare the redlines and the contingency language. ping me when the LOI arrives.

sam_se: i'll prepare a short POC checklist and timeline to attach to the quote — include expected integration milestones and the 2-3 week window for HSM BYOK.

maria_sales: thanks all — i'll update thread with customer response. :thumbsup:
